task_title: Stop the hourly sprite-queue reconciler ping-pong

plan_review.notes: The plan (PR description) proposed blob-history membership checks: (1) staleness — main never carried these bytes, (2) conflict — main current bytes known to source. Alt A: merge-base three-way diff was considered but rejected because the queue branch merge-base goes stale, blocking re-edits. Alt B: timestamp comparisons were rejected as unreliable (rebase/force-push changes timestamps). Alt C: CAS trailer retirement-only approach (the 2026-08-03 fix) was rejected because a stale source always differs by definition. The chosen approach is the minimal convergence gate on the delta. Divergence: convergent — alternatives were not materially superior.

rounds.notes: Round 1: apple tier under-declared (2->3, addressed by this ledger) and PNG+shard atomicity bug (A->B->A split-brain addressed by adding paired-counterpart suppression in filterPromotablePaths and a d5 regression test).
